name: Mandate Terminated
description:
Lifecycle Message emitted by the standard termination operation or another
authorized mandate operation.

The inherited termination workflow applies the terminal lifecycle transition
when the current status permits it, derives terminatedAt from the root causal
Timeline Entry, and requests graceful processing termination. A failed
mandate may therefore stop processing without replacing its failure state.
This Message does not supply the effective timestamp and is not re-emitted by
the accepting workflow. The inherited inResponseTo field may identify the
Message that invoked termination.

reason.description: Optional human-readable or machine-generated termination reason.
